section.content: 本实用新型涉及基因检测技术领域，且公开了一种用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备。该用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备,包括壳体、端盖、扶手、支撑架、输送管、检测仪、基因探针、底座、固定板和调节装置。该用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备，当设备出现故障时，壳体向上提起，使得滑轮离开限位槽，向右推动壳体，滑轮的设置能够减小与凹槽底部的摩擦,同时圆形槽与圆形杆的配合，能够实现270°的防晃动现象，而传统的T型槽及T型杆只能在X及Y方向上进行限定晃动，并不能实现让壳体平稳移动，通过滑轮能够改变面与面的直接接触，造成摩擦力过大，导致运行不平稳的现象，当移动到底座的右端时，从而使得壳体内部设备暴露在外面，方便检修。

The utility model relates to a gene detection technical field just discloses a gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering. The gene detection equipment for biological gene engineering comprises a shell, an end cover, a handrail, a support frame, a conveying pipe, a detector, a gene probe, a base, a fixing plate and a regulating device. This a gene check out test set for biological gene engineering, when equipment breaks down, the casing upwards mentions, make the pulley leave the spacing groove, promote the casing right, the setting of pulley can reduce the friction with the recess bottom, circular recess and circular rod's cooperation simultaneously, can realize 270 prevents rocking the phenomenon, and traditional T type groove and T type pole can only prescribe a limit to rock in X and Y direction, can not realize letting the casing steady movement, can change the direct contact of face and face through the pulley, cause frictional force too big, lead to the phenomenon of operation unstability, when removing the right-hand member of base, thereby make casing internal plant expose in the outside, convenient maintenance.

Gene detection equipment for biological gene engineeringTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a gene detection technical field specifically is a gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering.

Background

The gene is a genetic basic unit, carries DNA or RNA sequence of genetic information, transmits the genetic information to the next generation through replication, and guides the synthesis of protein to express the genetic information carried by the gene, thereby controlling the character expression of organism individuals. The gene detection is a technique for detecting DNA by blood, other body fluids or cells, and is a method for taking peripheral venous blood or other tissue cells of a detected person, amplifying the gene information, detecting DNA molecular information in the cells of the detected person by a specific device, and analyzing whether the gene type, the gene defect and the expression function contained in the DNA molecular information are normal or not, so that people can know the gene information of themselves, determine the cause of disease or predict the risk of the body suffering from a certain disease, and the gene detection can diagnose the disease and can also be used for predicting the risk of the disease.

At present, aiming at the defects of the existing gene detection equipment, firstly, the maintenance of the gene detection equipment is carried out, the shell of the existing equipment is mostly difficult to disassemble, the trouble is brought to the maintenance of the equipment, secondly, the equipment which has strict requirements on time is used for gene detection, the disassembling time is obviously better and better, and the slow overhauling time can have certain influence on the experimental result.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

Not enough to prior art, the utility model provides a gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering possesses convenient to overhaul and dismantles advantage such as quick convenient, has solved the problem that overhaul of the equipments is inefficient.

The utility model provides a technical scheme that its technical problem adopted is: the utility model provides a gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering, includes casing, end cover, handrail, support frame, conveyer pipe, detector, gene probe, base, fixed plate and adjusting device, the top movable mounting of casing has the end cover, the left side surface middle part fixed mounting of casing has the handrail, the bottom movable mounting of casing has the base, base top left and right sides fixed mounting has the support frame, the middle part fixedly connected with conveyer pipe of support frame, the top middle-end fixed mounting of base has the detector, the top fixed mounting of detector has the gene probe, the left end fixed mounting of base has the fixed plate, adjusting device is installed between base and the casing.

Adjusting device includes recess, circular rod, pulley, supporting leg, damping spring and spacing groove, both ends about the top of base are seted up to the recess, the circular recess has been seted up to the recess middle part left and right sides, the equal fixed mounting in the bottom left and right sides of casing has the circular rod, the bottom fixed mounting of casing has the supporting leg, the bottom swing joint of supporting leg has the pulley, the cover is equipped with damping spring on the supporting leg circumference, the spacing groove has all been seted up at both ends about the recess.

Furthermore, the area of the fixing plate is matched with the area of the side face of the shell, and the fixing plate is fixedly installed at the left end of the groove.

Furthermore, the shell is formed by enclosing a front surface, a rear surface and a right side surface, and the right side surface of the shell is connected with the base in a sliding manner.

Furthermore, grooves are formed in two sides of the upper surface of the base, and the length of each groove is matched with that of the base.

Furthermore, the matching relationship between the circular groove and the circular rod is clearance fit, and the side of the circular groove close to the groove is provided with a through groove, and the length of the circular groove is matched with the length of the groove.

Furthermore, the bottom end of the pulley is movably connected with a groove, the left end and the right end of the groove are both provided with a limiting groove, and the matching relationship between the limiting groove and the pulley is clearance fit.

The utility model has the advantages that:

1. the gene detection equipment for the biological gene engineering is characterized in that when the equipment breaks down, the shell is lifted upwards slightly to enable the pulley to leave the limiting groove and then push the shell rightwards, because the bottom of the shell is provided with the supporting legs, the pulley and the damping spring, the arrangement of the pulley can reduce the friction with the bottom of the groove, the phenomenon that the shell shakes too much due to too much friction is avoided, meanwhile, the damping spring can effectively reduce the shaking amplitude, meanwhile, the cooperation of the circular groove and the circular rod can realize the shaking prevention phenomenon of 270 degrees, the traditional T-shaped groove and the T-shaped rod can only carry out limited shaking in the X direction and the Y direction, but the shell cannot stably move, in sum, the direct contact between the surface and the surface can be changed through the pulley, the friction force is too large, the unstable operation phenomenon is caused, when the shell is moved to the right end of the base, the fixing plate is separated from the, thereby make the inside equipment of casing expose the outside, convenient maintenance.

2. This a gene check out test set for biological gene engineering, after overhauing finishing, remove the casing left, when the left end that reachs the recess, the pulley slides in the spacing inslot, and the fixed plate seals the casing this moment to reach the effect of easy access and quick installation.

Detailed Description

The technical solution in the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1-4, a gene detection device for bio-genetic engineering, comprising a housing 1, an end cap 2, a handrail 3, a support frame 4, a delivery pipe 5, a detector 6, a gene probe 7, a base 8, a fixing plate 9 and an adjusting device 10, wherein the end cap 2 is movably mounted on the top of the housing 1, the housing 1 is defined by a front surface, a rear surface and a right surface, the right surface of the housing 1 is slidably connected with the base 8, the handrail 3 is fixedly mounted in the middle of the left surface of the housing 1, the base 8 is movably mounted at the bottom of the housing 1, grooves 1001 are respectively formed on two sides of the upper surface of the base 8, the length of each groove 1001 is matched with that of the base 8, the support frame 4 is fixedly mounted on the left and right sides of the top of the base 8, the delivery pipe 5 is fixedly connected in the middle of the support frame 4, the top of the detector 6 is fixedly provided with a gene probe 7, the left end of the base 8 is fixedly provided with a fixing plate 9, the area of the fixing plate 9 is matched with the side area of the shell 1, the fixing plate 9 is fixedly arranged at the left end of the groove 1001, and an adjusting device 10 is arranged between the base 8 and the shell 1.

The adjusting device 10 comprises a groove 1001, a circular groove 1002, a circular rod 1003, a pulley 1004, supporting legs 1005, a damping spring 1006 and a limiting groove 1007, wherein the groove 1001 is arranged at the left end and the right end of the top end of the base 8, the circular groove 1002 is arranged at the left side and the right side of the middle part of the groove 1001, the circular groove 1002 is in clearance fit with the circular rod 1003, a through groove is arranged at one side of the circular groove 1002 close to the groove 1001, the length of the circular groove 1002 is matched with that of the groove 1001, the circular rods 1003 are fixedly arranged at the left side and the right side of the bottom of the shell 1, the circular groove 1002 is matched with the circular rods 1003, the 270-degree shaking prevention phenomenon can be realized, the traditional T-shaped groove and T-shaped rod can only carry out limited shaking in the X direction and the Y direction, but the shell 1 can not be stably moved, the supporting legs 1005 are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the shell 1, the pulley 1005, cause frictional force too big, lead to the unstable phenomenon of operation, the cover is equipped with damping spring 1006 on the supporting leg 1005 circumference, and spacing groove 1007 has all been seted up at both ends about recess 1001, and pulley 1004's bottom swing joint recess 1001, and recess 1001 has all seted up spacing groove 1007 at both ends about, and spacing groove 1007 is clearance fit with pulley 1004's cooperation relation to reach the effect of convenient to overhaul and install fast.

When the device is used, the end cover 2 is opened, a material to be detected is injected into the inner conveying pipe 5, the material to be detected is fully contacted with the gene probe 7 through the conveying pipe 5 and then is detected through the detector, when the device breaks down, the shell 1 is lifted upwards slightly, the pulley 1004 is enabled to leave the limiting groove 1007, then the shell 1 is pushed rightwards, due to the fact that the supporting legs 1005, the pulley 1004 and the damping spring 1006 are arranged at the bottom of the shell 1, friction between the pulley 1004 and the bottom of the groove 1001 can be reduced, the phenomenon that the shell 1 shakes too much due to too much friction is avoided, meanwhile, the damping spring 1006 can effectively reduce shaking amplitude, meanwhile, due to the matching of the circular groove 1002 and the circular rod 1003, the shaking prevention phenomenon of 270 degrees can be achieved, the traditional T-shaped groove and T-shaped rod can only shake in the limited mode in the X and Y directions, but cannot enable, can change the direct contact of face and face through pulley 1004, cause frictional force too big, lead to the phenomenon of operation unstability, when moving the right-hand member of base 8, fixed plate 9 breaks away from casing 1 this moment, thereby make casing 1 internal plant expose in the outside, convenient maintenance, after the maintenance finishes, move casing 1 left, when the left end of reacing recess 1001, pulley 1004 slides in spacing groove 1007, fixed plate 9 seals casing 1 this moment, in order to reach the effect of convenient to overhaul and quick installation.

The previous description of the disclosed embodiments is provided to enable any person skilled in the art to make or use the present invention. Various modifications to these embodiments will be readily apparent to those skilled in the art, and the generic principles defined herein may be applied to other embodiments without departing from the spirit or scope of the invention. Thus, the present invention is not intended to be limited to the embodiments shown herein but is to be accorded the widest scope consistent with the principles and novel features disclosed herein.
